episode_title: Chris Harbert: Automated Testing in the AI World - Episode 427

real_qa.q: What is Testory and how does it handle test orchestration for Playwright, Cypress, and Selenium?
real_qa.r: Testory is a test orchestration platform that runs Playwright, Cypress, and Selenium test suites in parallel and gates deployments with evidence from every run. The platform enables customers to run tests in parallel, automatically collect results, and use those results as evidence for deployment decisions.

real_qa.q: What was Chris Harbert's keynote topic at TestCon Europe 2024?
real_qa.r: Chris Harbert's keynote at TestCon Europe focused on his 15-20 year journey in test automation, showing how all practitioners go through similar phases: starting with manual testing, moving to automation, then parallelizing tests, and finally achieving fast and reliable testing fully integrated with CI/CD pipelines. His goal was to help people skip ahead in their own testing journey rather than going through all the phases he had to experience.
real_qa.requete: TestCon Europe keynote test automation journey

real_qa.q: What is Cucumber-style or Gherkin format for behavior-driven development in testing?
real_qa.r: Cucumber-style testing uses given-when-then statements to define what a system should do in a format that both computers and humans can understand. For example: Given I logged in as an admin, when I click on the profile page, then I see the advanced settings tab. This approach helps define system behavior in natural language that can be automatically tested and is particularly useful for AI-generated test validation.

real_qa.q: How does Testory act as an early warning system for cloud infrastructure outages?
real_qa.r: Testory runs literally millions of tests per month for customers across their systems. When major infrastructure events occur like AWS S3 outages, US-East 1 region failures, or Cloudflare issues, customer tests start failing at higher rates than normal. This triggers alerts within Testory, allowing the platform to inadvertently function as an early warning system that detects external events before they are widely announced.

real_qa.q: Why are end-to-end tests critical for AI-assisted software development?
real_qa.r: End-to-end tests provide a yardstick to measure whether a system does what was intended, which is especially important when AI agents autonomously generate code. End-to-end tests written in Cucumber-style format explain in natural language what expectations are, allowing developers to see whether AI built what was asked for from a functional perspective. As AI increases code velocity, end-to-end tests help ensure shipping valuable customer experiences, not just code.
real_qa.requete: end-to-end tests AI autonomous code generation
